title: Bose's paper published under Einstein's endorsement

tellings.quote: >> and he sent one to Albert Einstein said, "Nobody's listening to me."

plain: In the 1920s, the Indian physicist Satyendra Nath Bose is said to have sent his paper to Albert Einstein, the German physicist, with the complaint that nobody was listening to him, and Einstein backed it so it got published. Greg Rogers, a doctor who has worked with NASA, the US space agency, tells it on Michels's show without naming a source, as an example of an outsider's idea getting through only because someone famous vouched for it.
